boxes.head: Gaya
boxes.question: What is this mysterious kingdom?
boxes.about: A cone helm, a surrender, a name Bidam will later use. The country is shown before it is explained.

boxes.head: Gwansan
boxes.question: Why does Baekje call it a betrayal?
boxes.about: An old wound named before the battle is told.

boxes.head: The cone helm
boxes.question: Who is the unnamed Gaya prince?
boxes.about: A cone helm at Gwansan. The book will not say who until Muryuk.

boxes.head: Yongsu
boxes.question: Who is the boy who talks to the dark?
boxes.about: The identity box stays shut.

boxes.head: Ghost Bridge
boxes.question: Who dressed the stones in one night?
boxes.about: Servants say goblins. Yongsu answers.

boxes.head: The peonies
boxes.question: Why do Taizong’s flowers have no scent?
boxes.about: The gift arrives the morning she is crowned.

boxes.head: Yushin-ah
boxes.question: Why may he never say her name again?
boxes.about: The last time he is allowed to say it.

boxes.head: The east star
boxes.question: Will Chunchu pick the vow back up?
boxes.about: He puts it down. He picks it up again.

boxes.head: The thumb
boxes.question: Why does Elder Satek keep his thumb down?
boxes.about: A tourney that decides nothing.

boxes.head: Gyebek’s word
boxes.question: Who did he give his word to?
boxes.about: The river does not say. Hwangsan spends it.

boxes.head: The burn
boxes.question: Where did Gyebek see Gesomun?
boxes.about: I saw Gesomun again.

boxes.head: Eye
boxes.question: Who is the junior who is always right?
boxes.about: A soldier who is right every time Yeon gives an order.

boxes.head: The coat
boxes.question: What is on Pumsuk’s coat?
boxes.about: Gotaso sees it. He said he would change it later.

boxes.head: The latch
boxes.question: Which room only opens from inside?
boxes.about: Yushin will kneel in rooms he would burn.

boxes.head: Hangyul
boxes.question: What does the kite cost?
boxes.about: The horse that carries him three times. The kite needs a life.

boxes.head: Yumjong
boxes.question: Why does he say Gaya out loud?
boxes.about: A door Bidam pretends not to see open.

boxes.head: Queen Heo
boxes.question: Whose blood will Bidam claim?
boxes.about: Suro plants the line without knowing.

boxes.head: The lamp
boxes.question: Why does the room come to Chunchu?
boxes.about: Wherever the room has to come to you.

boxes.head: Deer Rock
boxes.question: Who poured the brine this afternoon?
boxes.about: Mu’s sealed-box rite.

boxes.head: The pass
boxes.question: Who will hold Tanhyeon?
boxes.about: Sunchung begs from prison. In 660 nobody is there.

boxes.head: Nine omens
boxes.question: Does the country already know?
boxes.about: Toads in the pines.

boxes.head: Class 77
boxes.question: Who is the mended-sleeve boy?
boxes.about: Bidam should pick him.

boxes.head: Three choices
boxes.question: Which road will Silla take?
boxes.about: The envoy in Chang’an. Chunchu’s later embassy answers it.

boxes.head: The half sword
boxes.question: Who will come south with it?
boxes.about: Lady Ye plants it.

boxes.head: Traitor
boxes.question: Who does Gusesa mean?
boxes.about: He drops it at the Summit. The massacre pays it.

boxes.head: The screen
boxes.question: Who saw Maehwa?
boxes.about: A cheap screen. Gumil already knows when he gets home.

boxes.head: Suulbu
boxes.question: What does he keep the house for?
boxes.about: I’ll keep the house. Bihyung spends what Jinhung plants.

boxes.head: The fox
boxes.question: Who built the bridge?
boxes.about: The bridge throws the fox off its own stones.

boxes.head: The locked door
boxes.question: How does she get out?
boxes.about: Heaven picks the house-apart. She goes out through the drain.

boxes.question: When does the count end?
boxes.about: It starts in the yard. It ends when the head comes back.

Back When Tigers Smoked.aPlot: A trailer before the book: tigers, the fall, three kingdoms, the faces to come.

themes.label: Overture
themes.note: No one wants anything. Keep it as the cold open.

Queen Sunduk.aPlot: Dukman takes a throne nobody wants a woman to hold.
Queen Sunduk.bPlot: Yushin says her name one last time and walks to the wall.
Queen Sunduk.conflict: The court will not crown a woman.
Queen Sunduk.development: She reads the room. The kids play on the sand. A girl is missing.
Queen Sunduk.climax: The peonies have no scent. Taizong sent a joke.

themes.label: A woman on the throne
themes.note: The joke is the test.

Harmony Council.aPlot: Bidam breaks a 3–3 tie for Dukman.
Harmony Council.bPlot: Chunchu waits outside. His father taught him the room comes to you.
Harmony Council.conflict: The vote is 3–3. Chunchu is rejected.
Harmony Council.development: The flame turns blue. The Three Counts stall.
Harmony Council.climax: Bidam speaks. Yushin answers from the wall. The vote is 6–0.
Harmony Council.resolution: Dukman is queen. Bidam is the man who said yes.

themes.label: Who gets to choose a king
themes.note: Bone is the measure, until it isn’t.

Jade Gate Valley.aPlot: Bidam and Alchun want one clean war against a foreign enemy.
Jade Gate Valley.conflict: Silla wants a foreign war. The valley is empty.
Jade Gate Valley.development: The yard. A monk is a bead short. Two of Class 51 ride in.
Jade Gate Valley.climax: Five hundred men were hiding in the valley.
Jade Gate Valley.resolution: The war they wanted is not the war they get.

themes.label: Class 51
themes.note: Two men, one yard, a country that will pick between them.

Jinhung, the Cloud.aPlot: Sumekbu wants the border, then the girl, then a lighter robe.
Jinhung, the Cloud.bPlot: Suulbu keeps the house. A cone helm watches a king die.
Jinhung, the Cloud.conflict: Great Gaya still stands. Baekje is coming.
Jinhung, the Cloud.development: Gaya surrenders. Guhae and his sons take up new jobs in Silla.
Jinhung, the Cloud.climax: A slave takes King Sung’s head at Gwansan.
Jinhung, the Cloud.resolution: Jinhung has too many stones and a robe that no longer fits.

themes.label: The soft year
themes.note: A king who won too much and wanted less.

Prince Euija.aPlot: Euija wants one person the clans do not own.
Prince Euija.bPlot: Gyebek dives nineteen times for a word he will not explain.
Prince Euija.conflict: The eight clans already own his brothers.
Prince Euija.development: He dives with Gyebek. He gives him a name no clan picked.
Prince Euija.climax: Do you like the name, or me?
Prince Euija.resolution: Gyebek is his. The court still will not explain Gwansan.

themes.label: A name no clan picked
themes.note: The first thing that is his.

Eight Great Clans.aPlot: Satek against Yunbi, frozen by design.
Eight Great Clans.bPlot: A tourney that decides nothing. A thumb stays down.
Eight Great Clans.resolution: King Mu: learn their names. Nobody has settled four generations of anything.

themes.label: Clan over country
themes.note: A diagram of how power sits still.

Deer Rock.aPlot: Jijuk wants the Premier’s chair Yunbi has already bought.
Deer Rock.bPlot: Gyebek was not asked. A monk’s stamp, a rock that sweats.
Deer Rock.development: The old Premier dies · three names · brine poured since this afternoon · the night on the wall.
Deer Rock.climax: Dawn: Yunbi’s fresh seal bleeds. Jijuk’s dry one stands.
Deer Rock.resolution: The bottom step, the bet, the chant. A junior nobody rates takes the chair.

themes.label: A rite everyone means to rig
themes.note: The rock still picks.

Gunchogo, the 13th.aPlot: A chant on a wall. A sentence that will get a fortress burned.

themes.label: A country is a story
themes.note: Planted here. Euija will spend it.

Commander Yeon.aPlot: Gesomun wants to hold the east and stay out of Pyongyang.
Commander Yeon.bPlot: A traitor with no name. A boy in a doorway.
Commander Yeon.resolution: The seal is pushed across the table. He will go.

themes.label: Half
themes.note: The father’s measure becomes the son’s.

Five Tribes.aPlot: Gesomun wants his pregnant wife to the old house before the Summit, at the pace of an ox.
Five Tribes.bPlot: Eye is right every time Yeon gives an order.
Five Tribes.development: The cart · singing ice · shut doors · the five stones · the raft · the pine axle.
Five Tribes.resolution: Pyongyang from the ridge. The unasked name waits.

themes.label: Whose are you?
themes.note: Five roofs. One question he will not answer.

High Summit.aPlot: Gesomun wants the Summit to prepare for Taizong.
High Summit.bPlot: Namseng is born while the room calls his father a traitor.
High Summit.climax: Gusesa drops the word traitor. The people cheer.
High Summit.resolution: You will have to keep it. A newborn, and a list.

themes.label: King for All
themes.note: The budget that will bury him.

Gwanggeto, the Great King.aPlot: A stele and a question: why are they still here?

themes.label: The record on the stone
themes.note: A stub that belongs with Stele.

Bupmin.aPlot: Bupmin wants the headband to mean something besides his father’s name.
Bupmin.bPlot: Yushin will not be his uncle on the dust.
Bupmin.development: The Class 82 gate · the picking · the throat · Gotaso at the pine · gyuku.
Bupmin.climax: The Five Precepts. Which will you break first?
Bupmin.resolution: Three disciples. The wall into Sadaham.

themes.label: A borrowed name
themes.note: The headband is not yet his.

Sadaham.aPlot: Sadaham wants to ride to war with Mugwan and keep their swear.
Sadaham.bPlot: Bupmin asks which principle you break first.
Sadaham.conflict: The king wants captives. Sadaham swore with Mugwan.
Sadaham.development: He begs for the prisoners. Then he stops eating.
Sadaham.climax: Seven days. Who would you stop eating for?
Sadaham.resolution: He cuts the ropes. Friendship is the principle he will not break.

themes.label: Friendship
themes.note: The one principle he will starve for.

Gotaso.aPlot: Gotaso wants to pick her own life before someone picks it for her.
Gotaso.bPlot: Chunchu wants his daughter back. Nineteen li.
Gotaso.development: Abduction · the ford · gyuku · flowering trees.
Gotaso.climax: Four children. There is something on your coat.
Gotaso.resolution: She chooses Pumsuk out loud. The coat will wait.

themes.label: Picking her own life
themes.note: Having been carried home is why she chooses fast.

Pumsuk.aPlot: Chunchu hands him Daeya as a wedding gift. He is too green for it.
Pumsuk.bPlot: Sunduk and Yushin miss each other in a lantern street.
Pumsuk.development: Munhee objects · the vow · the couple leaves · lantern-sellers.
Pumsuk.climax: The vow. A fortress as a dowry.
Pumsuk.resolution: They ride west. The near-miss stays a near-miss.

themes.label: A vow that is a trap
themes.note: Kindness is not a want. The fortress is.

Munhee.aPlot: Munhee wants Chunchu and the dream she bought.
Munhee.bPlot: Her brother stages a scandal so the country has to say yes.
Munhee.development: Buying the dream · the torn coat · the closed months.
Munhee.resolution: Bupmin is born. Let it just be a star. Chunchu puts the east star down.

themes.label: A scandal as a door
themes.note: She buys a dream and walks through fire for it.

Academy.aPlot: Gesomun wants a third leg for the pot that does not own a farm.
Academy.bPlot: Namseng is caught at Boduk’s lesson. The east room empties.
Academy.development: Spring gate · summer Daoist chair · autumn empty room · winter county schools.
Academy.climax: Gusesa’s supper. The seal argument in the boys’ room.
Academy.resolution: Enrolment as a campaign. No turn yet — the list is still being written.

themes.label: Who the country teaches
themes.note: A pot with three legs. The monasteries have two.

Stele.aPlot: A stone. Sons who think it is a big rock.

themes.label: A big rock
themes.note: The irony is Namseng’s later question.

Dosuryu.bPlot: The king and Gusesa plot in secret.
Dosuryu.climax: The laugh stops. I’ll make a list too.
Dosuryu.resolution: The guest list is a kill list. Summer will be bowing.

themes.label: A warning he will not take
themes.note: The friend who puts his boots on.

King Euija.aPlot: Euija wants to own his country through stories.
King Euija.bPlot: Gyebek will not lie. Seongchung still has a conscience.
King Euija.development: The fake dragon · the miracles list · the Rock · the maids.
King Euija.climax: How fortunate the rock has such good taste.
King Euija.resolution: Pung is sent away. The theatre has a price.

themes.label: A country is a story
themes.note: He is the one licensed to say the book’s idea out loud.

Yunchung.aPlot: Euija wants a war abroad to win the court at home.
Yunchung.bPlot: The Assembly, and a rock that can be made to sweat.
Yunchung.development: Yunchung on the good cushion · the shipping writ.
Yunchung.climax: A country is a story. Daeya by autumn.
Yunchung.resolution: The war is decided. Gyebek’s saving-you is the cost.

themes.label: A country is a story
themes.note: He says it in a room that will die for it.

Gwansan.aPlot: King Sung wants not to be Gaya next.
Gwansan.bPlot: A cone helm watches. A slave walks home under a Silla cloud.
Gwansan.conflict: Baekje sent gifts. Silla kept the Han flags.
Gwansan.development: King Sung marches first. The ditch is already waiting.
Gwansan.climax: A slave takes the head and walks it home.
Gwansan.resolution: Baekje calls it a betrayal. Silla has the Han.

themes.label: I am Silla tonight
themes.note: Leave that line to Muryuk.

Gumil.aPlot: Gumil wants clothes for his wife, and a rank the True Bone boy just rode in on.
Gumil.bPlot: Yushin wants counsel. Seohyeon wants water.
Gumil.conflict: A True Bone boy rides into Gumil’s own yard.
Gumil.development: The cavern. Maehwa walks the cheap screen. The feast starts without him.
Gumil.climax: He is passed over in his own house.

themes.label: Classism
themes.note: A True Bone boy rides in. The local man is furniture.

Maehwa.aPlot: Maehwa wants to be the one in control, to ruin the boy a little.
Maehwa.bPlot: Pumsuk keeps his self-control. Then he doesn’t.
Maehwa.conflict: She reaches up. He is True Bone.
Maehwa.development: He can’t sleep. She teaches him. They fall.
Maehwa.climax: She loses control. He leaves without a word.

themes.label: Hypergamy
themes.note: She reaches up. The reaching undoes her.

Siege of Daeya.aPlot: Gumil wants revenge. The gate opens from the inside.
Siege of Daeya.bPlot: Gotaso wants her husband to face her. Kangrim will ask the question.
Siege of Daeya.development: The confession · three weeks · Mochuk’s question.
Siege of Daeya.climax: Everyone is trash. The men march out and are cut down.
Siege of Daeya.resolution: Grief in Surabol. Chunmyung’s knee. The coat is paid.

themes.label: Classism, spent
themes.note: The local man opens the gate.

Yeon’s Massacre.aPlot: Gesomun wants the country. The Summit planned to bury him.
Yeon’s Massacre.bPlot: His wife’s promise. A king who will sit.
Yeon’s Massacre.climax: The speech. Bojang. You there — what is your name?
Yeon’s Massacre.resolution: Tell them that too. The closed kingdom begins.

themes.label: The guest list was a kill list
themes.note: Every Summit line pays off.

Chunchu & Yeon.aPlot: Chunchu wants Goguryeo’s troops and to make it home in sixty days.
Chunchu & Yeon.bPlot: Yeon’s price for the passes. A bleeding hand. A rabbit.
Chunchu & Yeon.development: Sixty days · Hadong · the cell · turtle-and-rabbit.
Chunchu & Yeon.climax: The letter. Yushin’s camp on the clock.
Chunchu & Yeon.resolution: Released on the king’s word. The empty saddle is the image he keeps.

themes.label: King for All
themes.note: He will pick the star back up.

Euija & Yeon.aPlot: Euija wants Goguryeo’s troops against Silla.
Euija & Yeon.bPlot: The same single price, and a blade on the table.
Euija & Yeon.resolution: No troops. A warning about the man who just left.

themes.label: Politics is alchemy
themes.note: Two kings, one price.

Nangbi.aPlot: Yushin wants to turn a lost battle and earn his father’s word.
Nangbi.bPlot: Yeon Taejo reads the report three times.
Nangbi.climax: Your helmet’s crooked. Hangyul is named.
Nangbi.resolution: Then I’ll kill him before they stop. A horse for eighteen years.

themes.label: Duty
themes.note: Three times. The horse is the witness.

Yushin.aPlot: Sunduk wants peace, then wants the forty back.
Yushin.bPlot: Yushin fetches the means from a bucket in the hill.
Yushin.development: Euija panic · unrest · the cavern · life flashbacks.
Yushin.climax: Forty. One river fort. The water is the turn.

themes.label: Duty
themes.note: He stands. He does not sit in lotus.

The Eastern Star.aPlot: Chunchu, Euija and Gesomun each want to be the King for All.
The Eastern Star.bPlot: Gyebek’s scar. I saw Gesomun again.
The Eastern Star.climax: Chunchu picks the star back up.
The Eastern Star.resolution: A thematic coda. The scar is the hook.

themes.label: King for All
themes.note: Three vows, no event. The box is the scar.

Four Dragons.aPlot: Taizong hears a name he will mispronounce.

themes.label: Teaser
themes.note: A card, not an episode.

Emperor.aPlot: The Second Emperor wants to finish what the Sui could not.
Emperor.bPlot: There will be no one left to tell him no.
Emperor.development: The name taboo · Wei Zheng’s deathbed · foreign reports · the muster.
Emperor.resolution: The war is his. The room will not say his name.

themes.label: No one left to tell you no
themes.note: Charm as a weapon.

Sima Yi.aPlot: A young Goguryeo king wants a teacher in the West.
Sima Yi.bPlot: Sima Yi wants a friend who will not ask him to hurry.
Sima Yi.development: A horse trader’s lie · the thousand-li ride · the empty camp stool.
Sima Yi.resolution: The cost lands on Dongcheon. The wait was the friendship.

themes.label: Friendship
themes.note: Distance is the conflict.

Yodong.aPlot: The Second Emperor wants the fortress that held off the Sui.
Yodong.bPlot: A bride offered to Jumong. Twelve days.
Yodong.development: The Blue Dragon walks the wall · the marsh · he carries earth.
Yodong.climax: The south wind, the fire, the fall.
Yodong.resolution: A list of other forts. History? I am the one writing it.

themes.label: I am writing it
themes.note: The showdown belongs at Ansi.

Boiling River.aPlot: Dongcheon wants a third victory. He does not look at the ground.

themes.label: The king who did not look at the ground
themes.note: A caution for Stallion Mountain.

Stallion Mountain.aPlot: Xue Rengui wants his hour. Sul Gedu wants the cap, the sash and the sword.
Stallion Mountain.bPlot: Namseng wants to save his brother.
Stallion Mountain.climax: The emperor praises Xue. Sul gets his lying down.
Stallion Mountain.resolution: Namseng takes the flogging. The boy who refused the Tang will one day go over.

themes.label: Wrong bones
themes.note: Two outsiders at the same muster.

Colossal River.aPlot: Ulchi Mundeok wants to lure a host to a river.

themes.label: Seven surrenders
themes.note: The best trick in the record, told in a clause.

Ansi.aPlot: The Guardian wants to hold the wall for a country whose dictator he defied.
Ansi.bPlot: The emperor himself, and a mound that slumps.
Ansi.development: The unnamed chief · sixty days · the collapse.
Ansi.climax: He seizes the slumped mound. An arrow at a helmet.
Ansi.resolution: Silk at the foot of the wall. A bow. Crazier than we are.

themes.label: One person to serve
themes.note: He defied Yeon and still held.

Haemosu.aPlot: Yuhwa wants the sun god, on her own terms.
Haemosu.bPlot: Habek will not have a sky man in his river.
Haemosu.development: The chariot stops · the copper room.
Haemosu.climax: Exile. The fox leads her to Geumwa.
Haemosu.resolution: The egg. He has already gone.

themes.label: I looked up
themes.note: A god who takes and a river girl who invites.

Buyeo.aPlot: Jumong wants to survive Daeso and get out.
Buyeo.bPlot: Haemosu stops a reaper. A horse starved then fattened.
Buyeo.development: The unbreakable egg · the knife in the dark.
Buyeo.climax: The turtle bridge. The three-legged crow.
Buyeo.resolution: He crosses. The half sword is still in the north.

themes.label: Get out
themes.note: A boy the house will not keep.

Jolbon.aPlot: Sosuno wants Jumong and will not admit it.
Jolbon.bPlot: Jumong wants a roof of his own. The well is where they count.
Jolbon.development: Tabal’s hall · the bow that will not bend · the well · the grain room.
Jolbon.climax: The pine shot. The vermilion cord.
Jolbon.resolution: A kingdom from a yard. Everything after is a second episode told as a list.

themes.label: The well
themes.note: She prices a kingdom. He cannot count grain.

Gi (起).aPlot: Bidam wants the throne to go to the cleverest person, not the last Sacred Bone.
Gi (起).bPlot: Yumjong says Gaya. A door he pretends not to see.
Gi (起).development: The vote · the lone hand · Biryun at the Class 51 gate · watching Jinji.
Gi (起).climax: The queen promotes the man who told her council no.
Gi (起).resolution: He recruits. The word Gaya sits on the table.

themes.label: Cleverest, not last
themes.note: The no that crowned her is the no that will unseat her.

Suro.aPlot: Suro wants Queen Heo. Before that, Ibiga wants the mountain.
Suro.bPlot: Six eggs and a Turtle Song.
Suro.conflict: Six eggs on a shore. No country yet.
Suro.development: Ibiga takes the mountain. The eggs hatch. Six brothers take the hills.
Suro.climax: Queen Heo arrives from the south.
Suro.resolution: Gaya has a name, a queen, and a bloodline Bidam will use.

themes.label: A country that is only a name
themes.note: My country is gone.

Seung (承).aPlot: Bidam wants Yushin, and the country, to admit his ideas are right.
Seung (承).bPlot: Chunchu wants a weakness. The conscience water shows nothing.
Seung (承).development: The cut Maitreya · nightly tea · Jade Gate flashback.
Seung (承).climax: Have you ever considered the POSSIBILITY that your ideas are simply terrible?
Seung (承).resolution: The splash is empty. The rant is the turn.

themes.label: The real Sillans
themes.note: Yushin keeps him talking on purpose.

Muryuk.aPlot: Muryuk wants to prove he is Silla, so his sons will not have to.
Muryuk.bPlot: The cone that still says Gaya.
Muryuk.conflict: Gaya surrenders. Guhae and his sons take up new jobs in Silla.
Muryuk.development: Muryuk rises as a Silla general. He meets Sadaham, a young hwarang who inspires new hope and makes him want a son.
Muryuk.climax: He names himself. He says Dodo. He does not look away.
Muryuk.resolution: His grandson will not have to prove it.

themes.label: Assimilation
themes.note: He does the dying so the sons can be from here.

Jeon (轉).aPlot: Yushin wants to defeat Bidam without losing himself.
Jeon (轉).bPlot: Hangyul. The kite needs a life.
Jeon (轉).development: The empty sixth night · the headband · Bidam expelled · the cavern.
Jeon (轉).climax: He kills the horse that saved him. Because it is ours.
Jeon (轉).resolution: The score breaks. The beads go on a bridle.

themes.label: Duty
themes.note: Choosing Silla with his own hands.

Seohyun.aPlot: Seohyeon wants Manmyung. The Gaya stain wants to be forgiven.
Seohyun.conflict: Her father locks the door. Heaven has already picked the house.
Seohyun.development: The horse keeps getting lost. She spends three days looking at a drain.
Seohyun.climax: Lightning takes the door. She crawls out in good silk.
Seohyun.resolution: They ride to Manno. The second generation will not have to ask.

themes.label: Second-generation assimilation
themes.note: Muryuk did the dying. Seohyun does the living.

Gyul (結).aPlot: The rebellion ends. A head comes back to the dirt.
Gyul (結).bPlot: Alchun goes pale. Blood is inevitable.
Gyul (結).development: The last morning · the yard · the count.
Gyul (結).climax: The head on the packed earth where they first met.
Gyul (結).resolution: 108–108 is over. Yushin mounts. The order stands.

themes.label: Because it is ours
themes.note: The yard keeps the score until it is blood.

Queen Jinduk.aPlot: A sister takes a throne that was never meant to last.

themes.label: The second queen
themes.note: A fragment between Bidam and the embassy.

Huangdi (皇帝).aPlot: Chunchu goes to Chang’an to buy a war with a country that does not need him.
Huangdi (皇帝).bPlot: Wu at the screen. Taizong mispronounces a name.
Huangdi (皇帝).development: The embassy · the hall · the three choices answered.
Huangdi (皇帝).climax: The emperor agrees. The price is Silla’s pride.
Huangdi (皇帝).resolution: A war is bought. The man who bought it will not live to spend it all.

themes.label: Buying a war
themes.note: The east star, spent in a foreign hall.

Jiabeng (駕崩).aPlot: An emperor dies. The room changes owners.

themes.label: The death of an emperor
themes.note: A hinge, not a story.

Royal Secretariat.aPlot: The new hall learns who writes the country.
Royal Secretariat.bPlot: A chorus of clerks, and a man who will not sit.

themes.label: Who writes the country
themes.note: Too many mouths. Not enough want.

King Muyeol.aPlot: Chunchu takes the name the east star promised.

themes.label: The name
themes.note: The vow, finally worn.

Jahee.aPlot: Ocean-trade sums on an eastern quay.

themes.label: The harbour marriage
themes.note: Ledgers, then a wife.

Hyukgosé.aPlot: An egg, a horse, six chiefs. The country invents itself.

themes.label: Founding myth
themes.note: Ink for the egg. Heewon for the crowning.

Talhae.aPlot: A stranger walks in and demands the throne.
Talhae.bPlot: A hawk, an eagle, a falcon.

themes.label: The man from the sea
themes.note: Suro’s missing climax, told here.

Alji.aPlot: A gold box in a wood. A cock that will not stop.

themes.label: The box in Sirim
themes.note: Ink in the wood. Heewon at court.

Exile.aPlot: Pung is sent away. A prince learns what a story costs.

themes.label: Exile
themes.note: The price of the theatre.

Heaven–Earth King.aPlot: The sky splits. Two suns. A grandfather telling a tale he was present for.

themes.label: Myth
themes.note: Joseon ink, on purpose.

Sulmun.aPlot: A giantess and a mountain that will not stay put.

themes.label: Island myth
themes.note: Tamla’s grandmother.

Three Princes.aPlot: Three boys, one well, a country that is an island.

themes.label: Tamla founding
themes.note: A well as a womb.

Stone Lady.aPlot: A woman waiting turns to stone.

themes.label: Waiting as a fate
themes.note: The island’s other grandmother.

Gardener.aPlot: A man who tends what the gods left.

themes.label: Tending
themes.note: Small, finished, enough.

Jachungbi.aPlot: A goddess who will not be a wife the way the story wants.

themes.label: Refusal
themes.note: Tamla’s own terms.

Kangrim.aPlot: The psychopomp reads a name and asks the only question he is licensed to ask.

themes.label: Were you X, or Y?
themes.note: His ritual. Do not vary it.

Tribute.aPlot: What a country sends when it cannot send men.

themes.label: Tribute
themes.note: A ledger, not a turn.

Coup.aPlot: The room changes owners again. This time from the inside.

themes.label: From the inside
themes.note: A door the narrator has watched before.

Descent.aPlot: Gods come down. The three realms remember they are family.

themes.label: Descent
themes.note: Hannim’s gossip, not scripture.

Nine Omens.aPlot: The country answers before the army does.
Nine Omens.bPlot: Toads in the pines. A guard with a lantern.
Nine Omens.resolution: Sabi already knows. The court will pretend it does not.

themes.label: The country knows first
themes.note: Weather as plot.

Onjo.aPlot: A second son wants a country that is not his brother’s.
Onjo.bPlot: Wirye. The south. A house from nothing.

themes.label: The second house
themes.note: Baekje begins as a refusal.

Sunchung.aPlot: Sunchung wants the pass held. He is in prison.
Sunchung.bPlot: Euija will not listen. The door is already open.
Sunchung.resolution: The ask is the plant. 660 will pay it with an empty pass.

themes.label: The man in prison
themes.note: The last honest ask.

Hungsu.aPlot: A man who already lost tries to save what is left.

themes.label: Too late
themes.note: The other warning.

Gyebek.aPlot: Gyebek wants five thousand to mean something.
Gyebek.bPlot: He kills his family first so nothing can be used against him.
Gyebek.development: The house · the road to Hwangsan.
Gyebek.climax: The reverse grip. The last line.
Gyebek.resolution: Kangrim will ask. The word is finally spent.

themes.label: Nothing to use against him
themes.note: The captain who holds his sword backwards.

Three Realms.aPlot: Living, Dead, and the Western Flower Field keep house.

themes.label: 삼계
themes.note: A map of heaven, not a plot.

Yellow Mountain.aPlot: Gyebek meets fifty thousand with five thousand.
Yellow Mountain.bPlot: Yushin wants the field. Gwanchang wants a name.
Yellow Mountain.development: The last line · the boys · the disputed blade.
Yellow Mountain.climax: The field is taken. The reverse grip ends.
Yellow Mountain.resolution: Kangrim’s question. Hwangsan is the grave of a word.

themes.label: Five thousand
themes.note: A man measured by self-control, spent.

Sabi.aPlot: The capital falls. Euija wants one more story.
Sabi.bPlot: The ford was empty. Sunchung was right.

themes.label: The last story
themes.note: A country is a territory governed by a single story.

Buyeo Euija†.aPlot: Kangrim reads the name. Were you a king, or a storyteller?

themes.label: The question
themes.note: His ritual.

Kim Chunchu†.aPlot: Kangrim reads the name. Were you a king, or a man who bought a war?

themes.label: The question
themes.note: The east star, put down for good.

Ungjin Commandery.aPlot: The Tang rename a country and call it administration.

themes.label: A commandery
themes.note: The story is being rewritten from the west.

King Pungjang.aPlot: The exiled son comes back with Yamato ships.
King Pungjang.bPlot: A restoration that is already late.

themes.label: The returned son
themes.note: Theatre, with other people’s boats.

Pyongyang I.aPlot: The first try at the northern capital.

themes.label: Not yet
themes.note: A wall that still holds.

Snake River.aPlot: A river that will not stay a border.

themes.label: The snake
themes.note: Water as a plot.

Tamla Surrenders.aPlot: The island sends a word instead of an army.

themes.label: Surrender as weather
themes.note: Tamla knows when a story is over.

Rebellion.aPlot: A rising that already has its ending written.

themes.label: Do not announce the failure
themes.note: Show the want. Withhold the fall.

Betrayal.aPlot: The sad thing about betrayal is that it never comes from your enemies.

themes.label: Betrayal
themes.note: A door opened from the inside.

White River.aPlot: Four fleets in one mouth. Four hundred eastern ships burn.
White River.bPlot: Gyebek’s ford, reused by other men.

themes.label: The first time all four met
themes.note: A river that keeps its name.

Yeon Gesomun†.aPlot: Kangrim reads the name. Were you a guardian, or a dictator?

themes.label: The question
themes.note: Half, son.

Brothers’ Coup.aPlot: Namseng’s brothers want the house. The boy who took a flogging goes west.

themes.label: The sons
themes.note: The flogging, paid.

Pyongyang II.aPlot: The northern capital falls. The wall Yeon walked is someone else’s.

themes.label: The second try
themes.note: This time the wall does not hold.

Dangun & Old Joseon.aPlot: A bear, a tiger, a cave. A grandfather naming a country.

themes.label: Joseon
themes.note: The word the book has been withholding.

Prosperity Mountain.aPlot: A field, a vow, a country that is now one story.

themes.label: One country
themes.note: The east star, on a mountain.

Ansung.aPlot: A name on a road. A fragment.

themes.label: Fragment
themes.note: Needs a want.

Letters.aPlot: Munmu wants the war in writing before it is in blood.

themes.label: The war on paper
themes.note: A king who writes.

Stone Gate.aPlot: A gate. A stand. A list.

themes.label: Fragment
themes.note: A battle without a face.

Wonsul.aPlot: A son who will not be his father’s duty.

themes.label: The son who refuses
themes.note: Yushin’s house, unfinished.

Kim Yushin†.aPlot: Kangrim reads the name. Were you a marshal, or a brother?

themes.label: The question
themes.note: He stood.

Munmu.aPlot: Bupmin wants the headband to have meant something. Now it is a crown.
Munmu.bPlot: The dragon. The east sea. A king who will not stay buried on land.

themes.label: The name that was a headband
themes.note: The Five Precepts, spent.

Maeso.aPlot: A fortress, a last Tang line.

themes.label: The last line
themes.note: Silla-Tang, almost done.

Final Ford.aPlot: The mouth of the Geum. Silla’s victory here ends the western war.
Final Ford.bPlot: Sunchung died begging someone to hold it.

themes.label: The ford, paid
themes.note: The prison ask, sixteen years late.

Wanggum.aPlot: A guest in a western capital. The king for all is a title someone else wears.

themes.label: The guest
themes.note: The book’s title, spent as irony.

Balhae.aPlot: A country rises where another fell. The story is not over.

themes.label: After
themes.note: The next episode card, as a country.

Bihyung.aPlot: A boy who talks to the dark is asked to put a bridge on a ditch.
Bihyung.bPlot: Suulbu’s house. Chunmyung’s sums. The fox that built it.
Bihyung.development: The night work · the dressed stones · the servants say goblins.
Bihyung.climax: By morning the Ghost Bridge is there.
Bihyung.resolution: The identity box stays shut. Yongsu walks the same stream.

themes.label: The streak
themes.note: Do not open the box.

Kim Yongsu.aPlot: Yongsu wants the night to stay useful, and Chunmyung to sit down beside the sums.
Kim Yongsu.bPlot: Chunchu is nine and learns to say nothing. Suulbu taps each stone.
Kim Yongsu.development: The goblins unmasked · rice cakes under the bridge · the madman’s arithmetic.
Kim Yongsu.climax: Yongsu is forced to kill Gildal, who reassures him.
Kim Yongsu.resolution: The fox is thrown off its own stones. The house keeps the weather.

themes.label: A bridge nobody ordered
themes.note: She married into that weather.
